sophia: Quick follow-up from the postmortem for INC-2026-03-12 — several remediation items are past due. can owners confirm status by EOD Fri? @matt @anika @jamie

anika: Thanks — posting a compact list. these are the overdue items I have: 
- #1: harden request timeouts on inference pool (owner: matt)
- #2: add rate-limit guard to metadata service (owner: jamie)
- #3: add alert for KV cache TTL drift (unassigned)
- #4: update runbook with rollback steps for model swap (owner: anika)

matt: I'll pick up #1. on my calendar tomorrow morning. ETA Thu EOD.

jamie: I thought I had done #2 — looks like PR didn't land. assigning back to me, will re-open and push fix today.

sophia: Good. @anika can you take #3 or assign to infra? this is the recurring pattern we flagged — KV cache drift pops every few months.

anika: I can take #3 but need a quick sync with infra to confirm metrics. tagging @matt for metric names.

matt: metric is `kv.cache.ttl_jitter` and the alert should trigger when 95th percentile > 20s for 5m.

ops-bot: Reminder: action item #4 (runbook update) due in 48 hours — assigned to anika.

jamie: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/infra/metadata/+/4321 — need review. cc @sophia

anika: Created draft runbook change in docs repo, need SMEs to review. ETA Fri AM.

sophia: If any of these slip past Fri EOD I'll escalate to Eng Leads and tag oncall. we can't let the same remediation lag after every incident.

jamie: Understood. I'll ping reviewers now.

matt: After I land #1 I'll also add a short test to CI to catch timeout regressions. should help break the recurring cycle.

sophia: OK — action items and owners set: matt(#1), jamie(#2), anika(#3,#4). please update the postmortem action tracker with final PR links and close items when done. I'll do a closure verification on Mon morning. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: action-tracker update: https://tracker.internal/inc/INC-2026-03-12/actions — last updated by jamie at 1773005300

jamie: Done with PR reviewer notes addressed, moving item #2 -> in-review.

matt: PR merged for #1 at 1773005400. marking item done in tracker.

anika: Runbook draft updated and link pushed to tracker. assigning SME reviewers.

sophia: Thanks all. I'll verify closures Mon and confirm no further escalation. if anything blocks you, drop a note here and I'll help unblock.

jamie: Thanks, will follow up if review stalls.

anika: Noted. will chase reviewers tomorrow.

ops-bot: Thread summary generated — 3 items in-progress, 1 done. Next verification: 1773091400 (Mon 09:00).
